title: ESMA Annual Statistical Report: Performance and Costs of Retail Investment Products in the EU 2020
notes: ESMA (EU supervisor, sells nothing). Bias: investor-protection mandate feeding the PRIIPs/Retail Investment Strategy agenda, so findings stressing high costs and active underperformance fit its policy line. URL says esma50-165-1106 but the cover prints ESMA 50-165-1098.
